approvalBoundary.sourceScope: pep-chinese-g1-upper-2022-standard / 20260924-directory-3 / u4-l4; printed51-53; five finals, three whole forms, three printed toned whole examples, six three-part whole outputs, 29 petal syllables and lun-chuan static writing phrase.
approvalBoundary.providerReuse: Unchanged Aliyun CosyVoice-v3-flash longanwen_v3 parameters, explicit py SSML, whole-token validation and original-WAV/PCM evidence. No new model, voice or provider route.
approvalBoundary.wholeTokenBoundary: Each Latin run must be one exact registered token. No normalization, alpha-a/ASCII-a alias, combining marks, numeric tone spelling, unknown syllable, per-letter fallback or constructed wrong combination.
approvalBoundary.baseFinalBoundary: Exact U+0251 token ɑn uses an1; ASCII an is not an alias. Standalone in/un/ün use complete yin1/wen1/yun1 demonstration recipes, following the full-syllable orthography convention of registered i/u/ü. These new requests have no inherited pronunciation or perceptual approval.
approvalBoundary.carrierBoundary: Carrier characters are inert phoneme-tag payloads, never vocabulary, definitions or replacements in lesson text. Explicit ph comes from the frozen textbook pinyin target and tone, not a guessed homophone reading.
approvalBoundary.componentBoundary: Visible g/k/h/j/q/x, u/ü and ān are not separately voiced by the 231 frozen speeches. No component support is registered and no complete output is assembled from component audio.
approvalBoundary.toneBoundary: Untoned five finals and three whole forms are first-tone demonstrations only. Register the three printed whole examples and actual six three-part outputs, 29 petal syllables and chuán; no expanded four-tone rows or Cartesian combinations.
approvalBoundary.neutralToneBoundary: men appears only in the shared-reading scope, not in the finite speech inventory; it is not registered as men5 or any toned token. Natural Chinese 我们 remains in its full sentence and requires separate formal verification. Prior bo5/li5 exceptions do not apply.
approvalBoundary.naturalChineseWords: Blue-sky/cloud/grassland/forest words and all other Chinese remain natural sentence speech; words is empty and there is no exactTextSsml override. Printed pinyin not actually voiced by this draft is not added as an audio target.
approvalBoundary.probeScope: Three server-owned fixed source texts cover all 46 actual tokens in 48 positions: five finals and three base wholes; three printed toned wholes and six whole three-part outputs; 29 petal syllables and full lún chuán.
approvalBoundary.scopeBoundary: Derived from preserved authoring draft raw SHA256 557a1b5b7d4ec6560443d5cfdffb9ccf3c16c6b9619cb89098caf2eac73d467e: 231 speeches, 89 Latin-bearing speeches, 91 Latin occurrences, 46 unique tokens. Existing policies and material remain unchanged.
approvalBoundary.publicationBoundary: Registration is not provider acceptance, audible correctness, formal audio, review, publication or student acceptance. Initialize through the existing v2 operator evidence contract; actual formal speech, original media and browser play require independent review.
